name: Duchies of Vinci
genericName: DaVinci Humans||Duchies of Vinci||Duchies of Vinci
background:
The Duchies of Vinci are an army of highly advanced Humans assisted by their robotic automatons. On the battlefield, they rely on ranged warfare using crossbows and cannons, supported by the more resilient Automa. 

They were once a collection of poor villages who discovered the intelligence-enhancing Mindstones in the aftermath of the Rift. The Vinci have gained great wealth and knowledge, but guard their secrets and their Mindstones closely to protect themselves from poverty. However, over time, their isolationism has fostered rivalry between the Duchies, causing them to stagnate.
backgroundFull:
The Vinci were once amongst the poorest people in Tyria, a meagre collection of villages built on swampland. Without any source of wealth, they were subsistence farmers who were largely disregarded by the wider Empire and other outsiders as mere peasants. 

When the Great Rift opened, the Vinci’s homelands were devastated by violent earthquakes. Soon after these quakes, however, glowing stones began to emerge from the depths of the swamps. At first, the stones were simply used to create jewellery, but soon the stones started to affect people’s minds and made them smarter, leading to a new time of technological and cultural progress. They became known as Mindstones soon after, and it was not long before the Vinci had taken every stone that they could find until almost none remained undiscovered. 

Influenced by their Mindstones, the Vinci started building machines to drain the swamps and reclaim the land. They expanded their farmland, built great cities, and became very rich, very quickly. The Vinci established universities that attracted the best minds in all the land, which led to the invention of robots known as Automa. These robots assisted the Vinci with farming, construction, and generally served to boost the advancement of the Vinci even more. 

As the Vinci began to prosper, they found themselves surrounded by enemies. Outsiders sought to claim these newfound riches for themselves and began to stake claims upon the Vinci and their Mindstones. When conflict broke out, the Vinci armies turned the tides and soon conquered their neighbours.

In order to defend themselves from future conflicts, the Vinci turned their cities into fortresses and expelled all foreign diplomats and scholars. The isolated Duchies became even more reliant on advanced technology to make up for their losses in trade. Now, Universities are the real power in Vinci, while Dukes have become mere figureheads. This led to them being highly insular and suspicious, with their universities waging secret wars of sabotage and espionage on each other. 

How will you ensure the prosperity of your duchy?

product.description: The Militia is an essential part of many Vinci armies. Following the commands of their Sergeant, these soldiers fight tooth and nail to hold the line or push through the enemy’s, either squaring off against light troops or pinning stronger enemies in place. Musicians and Banner-bearers serve to maintain the morale of these heroic citizens, encouraging their companions even as they face down more powerful and experienced foes.

Dressed in the colourful garb of street theatre performers, the Harlequins are one of the most colourful components of the Vinci armies. Wielding reinforced Clubs and unpredictable explosives, they sow chaos and confusion in enemy ranks whenever they join the fray.

Drones are flying Automa, equipped with twin weapons, either Crossbows or hacksaws. Their design represents the work of several collaborating Inventors and draws upon the innovations of many who came before them. Drones are often used to support infantry units, adding to their firepower, or protecting them in the event of an ambush, but some Captains deploy them as separate units, often to protect perimeters or vulnerable points in the line.

Armoured from head to toe and impeccably trained, the ranks of the City Guard are the anvil against which the enemy attacks slam ineffectively, when they are not busy firing volley after volley of lethal Crossbow bolts. They form the backbone of many armies from the Duchy, working in conjunction with the Militia to protect elite units when they are vulnerable.

The Automa Cavalry is an elite, prestigious role among the militaries of the Duchies of Vinci. Charging into battle in a tight formation, lances drawn, they can easily rout many infantry units and inflict serious harm to any foes standing their ground. They quite often work in conjunction with blocks of City Guards or Militia, waiting for the enemy to engage the infantry before smashing into his flank.

Masters of stealth and disguise, Assassins are the stuff of nightmares for those who fight the Duchies of Vinci. Equipped with Arm-Blades, Grenades, and many precise hidden weapons tucked into the folds of their clothes, these masked killers like to operate behind enemy lines, revealing themselves only when their foe is in range. They are impeccably trained in close combat, delivering lethal strikes before drawing back into the shadows.

Scouts are at the vanguard of many Vinci forces. While they lack the heavy armour of the City Guard, their mobility and offensive power make them a serious threat. As expert rangers, they scout the battlefield ahead of the main force and surprise the enemy in deadly ambushes, using their Rapid Armbows and their sharp blades. Whenever possible, experienced Captains dispatch a couple of Scout units ahead of their force to disrupt attack attempts and gather information.

Striding into battle with surprising speed, the Automa Guard is equipped with short blades and Armbows that they fire with an unerring determination. Constantly refined by the numerous Inventors of the Duchy, they are surprisingly durable machines that can be relied upon to hold key positions and endure assaults which might cause other units to flee.

The Snipebow is a very powerful shooting weapon, able to propel a steel bolt through a breastplate from a considerable distance. Trained in its use, Snipers are elite marksmen who support their comrades in arms on the battlefield from a distant vantage point. Safely concealed behind specialised shields equipped with spikes that can be stuck into the ground, these sharpshooters operate with ruthless efficiency, and no target is safe once it appears in their scopes.

The Aerea Guard is made up of skilled soldiers equipped with smaller versions of the helix-powered engine that propels the Vita Aerea, strapped to their backs. This technology allows them to fly high in the air and deploy as needed. Their bird-shaped helmets are equipped with sight-enhancing lenses, and they either carry Crossbows or Armblades.

A promising young inventor from a prestigious family, Ignatio is an expert with automa but struggles with people. From an early age, Ignatio has always been determined to step out from his wealthy family’s shadow. He believes that he will finally be able to do so with the aid of his most recent invention, a device that detects the intelligence enhancing mindstone which powers Vinci automa. He has obtained funding and loans in hopes of discovering new Mindstone deep in Saurian territory, near the ancient city of Tixal.

Hailing from the western Duchy of Noverra, Zairetia grew up as an Inventor’s apprentice. Her tutor noticed her curiosity and intelligence, encouraging her to continue her studies. But even after the University of Noverra granted her the title of Inventor, she felt unfulfilled. Eager to push the boundaries of science even further, she decided to learn Alchemy.

The stampede of a charging unit of Heavy Cavalry can be deafening. Their heavy Automa Boars are very powerful, able to charge at high speed and smash into enemy lines. Even when pinned down, their thick armour makes them difficult to damage and able to handle bitter melee fights. Capable of short bursts of speed, the Boar is not made to run for very long distances, but it is able to reposition quickly, making it very useful in dense terrain such as woods.

An experienced Vinci Captain, rarely seen without her beloved Automa Eagle, Carmia. Lucrezza retired from military service after losing her leg and the rest of her company in an ambush. Ignatio’s offer of employment has given this captain a chance at proving herself once more and redeeming her reputation. Her experiences have made her a more cautious commander, determined to protect those under her leadership.

A heavyweight variant of the classic Automa Guard, Automa Brutes are large mechanical constructs, powered by Mindstone and built for battle. Their Brute Lance, durability, and imperviousness to fear make them ideal to spearhead risky charges, face off against monsters, and hold choke points against overwhelming hordes.

Few things in war are more nerve-racking than looking down into the wrong ends of a Ribauldequin. Its five barrels can fire continuously until they turn red hot, and its rigorously trained crew are experts at getting the most out of this state-of-the-art Vinci machinery. The hail of pellets spewed forth by a well-maintained Ribauldequin is devastating to massed infantry, cutting them down like reeds. Even elite Cavalry have been known to break into panicked disorder as their charging lines collapse under the weight of a Ribauldequin volley.

Mantissa grew up in a small village in the border Duchy of Ortezza. Like many peasants of the Paretemi mountains, she learned to shoot a crossbow before she could walk. She made a name for herself as a child by winning several shooting contests. But when she was a teenager, most of Mantissa’s family was slain during a Daemon raid. She swore to avenge their deaths and became a mercenary, seeking employment with any Captain who was fighting Daemons.

product.description: Mambrecco is considered to be one of the “Old Dukes”, whose families were in power long before the technological revolution caused by the discovery of Mindstone. As such, he is a staunch traditionalist, known for despising scholars and merchants and priding himself on martial prowess only. A grizzled warrior, he has put his life on the line many times in defense of his title. His daughter Lucrezza is a capable commander in her own right, as he has trained her to be.

Columns of Support Wagons careening towards the frontline are a common sight during major Vinci campaigns. Protected by layers of tempered steel and drawn by sturdy Automa Horses, these vehicles can bring a unit where it is needed and provide cover fire with either Repeater Crossbow or Mortar.

Gerepetto Collodi once had a bright future. He was one of the rising stars of the University of Ollenna, a brilliant young Inventor with groundbreaking ideas for improving Automa design and autonomy. He spent every waking hour developing prototypes, working faster than any of his peers.

But over the years, Gerepetto changed. He would talk to the stars and declare that his next Automa would be a “real boy”. Despite his genius, people around him were worried that he had been driven insane by constant exposure to high quantities of Mindstone.

product.description: Propelled by an extremely complex helicoidal device, the Vita Aerea is a flying machine carrying a crew armed with Crossbows. It is primarily used for surveillance and reconnaissance, but it also has its uses on the field of battle. Captains have deployed Vita Aerea to spy on enemy movements, pick off stragglers from a distance, and even drop bombs over enemy formations.

Outfitted with no less than seven cannons and a Repeater Crossbow, the Carro Armato is a marvel of Vinci engineering, striking awe in the heart of foes as it rumbles towards them while spewing hellfire. It can be used both as mobile artillery support, decimating enemy units at a distance, and as a powerful battering ram capable of devastating anything it smashes into.

The Bull Titan is often nicknamed ‘The Siege Breaker’. Dwarfing the largest Automa Boar or Carro Armato, it is an overwhelmingly powerful Automa that can burst through most defenses, up to and including actual stone fortifications.

product.description: Among the ranks of the Duchies of Vinci, Alchemists hold a peculiar place. Unlike Inventors and Engineers with their mechanized creations, the Alchemists’ area of expertise lies in the occult and the arcane. Using their knowledge of the arcane to create potent potions, oils, and incense, which they may put to use either by healing the sick and wounded or sowing death and mayhem among the ranks of their enemies.

The Duchies of Vinci are renowned across Tyria for their technological prowess, so it comes as no surprise that Inventors have such a prestigious image. Experts in their field, these men and women accompany their army in campaign, maintaining and improving its Automa and weapons.

Master Assassins are the leaders of their Guild. Their exact number is kept secret, but there are few of them, as rising through the ranks of the Assassins’ Guild involves many close calls and hidden blades. They tend to wear a mask and travel secretly, so much so that sometimes the Vinci soldiers themselves don’t know they have this ace up their sleeves until the very last minute.

Captains are the leaders of the Vinci companies, the most elite commanders to be found within the Duchies. Veterans of many battles, they use their experience to direct their troops in the most efficient manner possible, often sending orders and receiving reports with the help of an Automa Pigeon.

Beautifully decorated in the colours of its Duchy or company, the Army Standard serves as a rallying point for Vinci soldiers. The accompanying sergeant can dispatch field orders and deliver rousing speeches or blustering insults to strengthen his comrades’ resolve, while the musician plays military hymns to set marching speed, announce charges, and draw the ranks.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Good Shot
specialRules.description: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Vinci Tech
specialRules.description: If this model has Versatile Attack, it always gets either AP(+1) or +1 to hit rolls from Versatile Attack (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: Quick Throw
specialRules.description: This model may always target enemies that are not in line of sight when shooting with Indirect weapons (instead of only when using Hold actions).

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Vinci Tech
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when this unit attacks enemies for the first time each round, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Ranged Slayer Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Fortified Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fortified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
specialRules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rapid Advance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Vinci Tech Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Vinci Tech. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Heavy Impact
specialRules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

specialRules.name: Entrenched
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12” away get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Cumbersome
specialRules.description: May only use Hold or Advance actions, but can’t shoot when moving.

specialRules.name: Piercing Spotter
specialRules.description: Once per activation, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(X) on their weapons, where X is the number of removed tokens.

specialRules.name: Precision Spotter
specialRules.description: Once per activation, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. Friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to hit to get +X to hit rolls when attacking, where X is the number of removed tokens.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: This model's melee weapons get AP(+2) against units where most models have Tough(12) or higher.

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Crossing Strike

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Puncture
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Versatile Warrior
specialRules.description: If this model has Versatile Attack, it always gets either AP(+1) or +1 to hit rolls from Versatile Attack (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Versatile Warrior
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when this unit attacks enemies for the first time each round, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Ambush

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Indirect
specialRules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

specialRules.name: Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting enemies over 9" away, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(27) or higher.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: AI units within 6” use the Villain’s Qua for Morale Tests if it’s better than their own, as long as the Villain isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Ranged Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(27) or higher.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance

specialRules.name: Impact
specialRules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.
